lines.text: Before they knew God, the Galatians were slaves to those who are not gods, and now they were turning back.
The Galatians were observing special days and months and seasons and years, and Paul feared his efforts for them were in vain.
Paul first preached the gospel to them because of a shipwreck, and they welcomed him as if he were an angel of God.
Paul said the Galatians would have given him their homes, and that those people wanted to isolate them from Paul's group.
Paul called the Galatians his children, was in the pains of childbirth for them, and wished he could change his tone.
